summary: The main behavior and precedence rules are clear, but two failure and compatibility cases need resolution before implementation.

findings.message: Resolve how changing reviewer settings preserves an existing passed code review when those settings reside in a fingerprinted configuration file.
findings.evidence: review-reviewer-settings/spec.md requires that changing configured code-review effort leaves an existing pass valid. However, src/core/review/fingerprint.ts fingerprints implementation files, including openspec/config.yaml, and readCurrentReview compares the snapshot hash. design.md says readiness and readCurrentReview are unaffected, and tasks.md includes no work to reconcile this behavior.
findings.reason: The acceptance scenario conflicts with the proposed unchanged fingerprint behavior. Specify how settings-only edits are distinguished from other configuration edits, and align design/tasks and compatibility validation.

findings.message: Define which findings limit_reached returns when the latest report is blocked and contains no findings.
findings.evidence: review-round-limit/spec.md explicitly skips blocked reports when counting but requires open findings from the most recent report. Existing runReview writes blocked reports with findings: [] on errors. A history of changes_required, blocked can therefore reach the limit while the prescribed response omits the unresolved findings. The agent guidance still requires summarizing remaining findings.
findings.reason: Specify whether to retrieve findings from the latest changes_required report or deliberately return an empty list with the blocked diagnostic, and add an acceptance case for a blocked latest report at the limit.
